Container.Name: Cleanplex
Container.Overview: Skips or mutes scenes you choose (nudity, violence, profanity and more) in Plex, for every client, including Plex Web. Cleanplex scans your library ahead of time and puts a filtering front door in front of Plex. On first start it reads Plex's URL, token and certificate from Plex's appdata folder, so there is nothing to configure by hand. Needs Plex to run on this server with host networking (the Unraid default); see the project page for the bridge-mode alternative.
Container.Requires: Plex Media Server running on this server with host networking, and claimed (signed in) so it has created its certificate.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port of the Cleanplex web UI (host network: the container uses it directly).

Config.Name: Plex appdata (read only)
Config.Description: Plex's appdata folder: the one that contains 'Library/Application Support/Plex Media Server'. Cleanplex reads the URL, token and certificate from it.

Config.Name: Media (same path as Plex)
Config.Description: Mount your media at the SAME path Plex sees it at, because Plex reports file paths and Cleanplex opens them to scan. Add one entry per Plex media mount, with the container path equal to Plex's.

Config.Name: CLEANPLEX_PLEX_DATA
Config.Description: Where the Plex appdata is mounted. Leave as is.

Config.Name: CLEANPLEX_REDIRECT
Config.Description: nft sends other machines' traffic for Plex's port 32400 through the Cleanplex front door and removes the rule when the container stops. Clear it to run without redirect (scan and mark only).

Config.Name: CLEANPLEX_FRONTDOOR
Config.Description: 0 runs without the front door (no stream filtering).

Config.Name: CLEANPLEX_CONFIGURE_PLEX
Config.Description: 1 switches Plex Relay and DLNA off on the first start (they bypass the front door). 0 leaves Plex's settings alone.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id to run as. Empty uses the owner of Plex's appdata (Unraid: 99).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id to run as. Empty uses the group of Plex's appdata (Unraid: 100).
